tagline.en: Ontario's first full freeway, built to take Toronto to cottage country, and still its road to the north
tagline.zh: 安大略第一条全封闭高速公路，为把多伦多人送往度假木屋区而建，至今仍是通往北方的大道

start.en: Maple Leaf Drive in north-west Toronto, where the freeway gives way to Black Creek Drive
start.zh: 多伦多西北部的枫叶大道，高速公路在此接黑溪大道

end.en: Highway 12 at Coldwater, the north end of this atlas piece; the freeway continues north towards Parry Sound and Sudbury
end.zh: 冷水镇的 12 号公路，即本图集此段的北端；高速公路继续北上通往帕里桑德与萨德伯里

en: Highway 400 runs due north from Toronto. It leaves the city between the suburbs of Vaughan, crosses the Oak Ridges Moraine and the drained market gardens of the Holland Marsh, and reaches Barrie on Kempenfelt Bay. North of Barrie it bends towards Georgian Bay and becomes the road to Muskoka, Parry Sound and, once the remaining two-lane sections of Highway 69 are rebuilt, Sudbury.

It is a commuter road at its southern end, widened as the suburbs of Vaughan grew along it and crossed by Highway 407 at a stack interchange, and a holiday road beyond, carrying weekend traffic to the lakes and cottages of Simcoe County and Muskoka.
It was the first of the 400-series highways, the province's numbered system of controlled-access freeways.
zh: 400 号公路自多伦多正北而行。它从沃恩郊区之间驶出城市，越过橡树岭冰碛丘陵与排干后改作菜园的霍兰沼泽，到达肯彭费尔特湾畔的巴里。巴里以北，它折向乔治亚湾，成为通往马斯科卡、帕里桑德的道路；待 69 号公路其余双车道路段改建完成后，还将直通萨德伯里。
它南段是通勤道路，随着沃恩郊区沿路发展而不断拓宽，并在一座多层立交处与 407 号公路相交；再往北则是度假道路，承载着周末前往锡姆科县与马斯科卡湖区木屋的车流。
它是 400 系列公路——该省有编号的全控制出入高速公路体系——中的第一条。

en: Planning for a dual highway from Toronto to Barrie began in 1944 and construction in 1945. Two lanes opened on 1 December 1951 and all four on 1 July 1952, making it Ontario's first full freeway with no level crossings. Just over two years later, in October 1954, Hurricane Hazel flooded the Holland Marsh beside it.

The extension north of Barrie to Craighurst and Coldwater opened on 24 December 1959 as a two-lane road on a four-lane right of way and was twinned from 1977. At the south end the freeway was extended to Jane Street in 1966, and Black Creek Drive took it further into the city in 1982. Widening began in 1971 as the suburbs of Vaughan grew up along it, and the stack interchange with Highway 407 opened on 7 June 1997.

In 1997 the province also began to extend the number north, renaming the rebuilt four-lane sections of Highway 69 towards Parry Sound and Sudbury as Highway 400. Of the 152 km from Parry Sound to Sudbury, 84 km had been widened by the mid-2020s and 68 km in six sections remained.
zh: 多伦多至巴里双幅公路的规划始于 1944 年，1945 年开工。1951 年 12 月 1 日开通两条车道，1952 年 7 月 1 日四车道全部开通，成为安大略第一条没有平交路口的全封闭高速公路。仅两年多后，1954 年 10 月，飓风“黑兹尔”淹没了公路旁的霍兰沼泽。
巴里以北至克雷格赫斯特与冷水镇的延伸段于 1959 年 12 月 24 日开通，在四车道用地上先建两车道，1977 年起加宽为双幅。南端方面，高速公路于 1966 年延伸至简街，1982 年再由黑溪大道深入市区。随着沃恩郊区沿路发展，拓宽工程自 1971 年开始；与 407 号公路的多层立交于 1997 年 6 月 7 日开通。
1997 年，该省还开始向北延伸这一编号，把 69 号公路通往帕里桑德与萨德伯里的已改建四车道路段改称 400 号公路。帕里桑德至萨德伯里的 152 公里中，到 21 世纪 20 年代中期已拓宽 84 公里，余下 68 公里分为六段。

value.en: 226.4 km for the whole of Highway 400 including the northern extension, summed from the province's 2024 traffic-volume sections; English Wikipedia gives 226.0 km. This atlas piece is the Toronto–Coldwater section.
value.zh: 400 号公路全线（含北延段）226.4 公里，据该省 2024 年交通量路段累加；英文维基百科作 226.0 公里。本图集此段为多伦多至冷水镇。

figures.source: Ontario Ministry of Transportation, Provincial Highways Traffic Volumes 2024 (computed); English Wikipedia, Ontario Highway 400

value.en: No final cost found for the original freeway. Reported at about $5 million as estimated in 1944 for the dual highway to Barrie; not checked against Ontario public accounts. Northern extension (Highway 69 to Sudbury): about $770 million spent by 2016 out of about $2 billion expected in total.
value.zh: 未查到原高速公路的最终造价。据报道，1944 年对通往巴里的双幅公路估价约 500 万加元；未经安大略公共账目核实。北延段（69 号公路至萨德伯里）：截至 2016 年已投入约 7.7 亿加元，预计总额约 20 亿加元。

figures.source: Barrie Today (quoting a local historian); Sudbury.com, 2016; Northern Ontario Business, 2008

value.en: The province, through the Department of Highways and its successor the Ministry of Transportation.
value.zh: 省政府，经由公路厅及其后继机构交通厅。

figures.source: Ontario Ministry of Transportation news releases on the Highway 69/400 widening; English Wikipedia, Ontario Highway 400

value.en: 152 km to four-lane; 84 km complete and 68 km remaining in six sections. One recent contract alone was $173.4 million.
value.zh: 152 公里改为四车道；已完成 84 公里，余下 68 公里分为六段。近期仅一份合同即达 1.734 亿加元。

timeline.en: Planning begins for a dual highway from Toronto to Barrie.
timeline.zh: 多伦多至巴里双幅公路开始规划。

timeline.en: Two lanes open to traffic on 1 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 1 日，两条车道通车。

timeline.en: All four lanes open on 1 July: Ontario's first full freeway.
timeline.zh: 7 月 1 日，四车道全部开通，成为安大略第一条全封闭高速公路。

timeline.en: Hurricane Hazel floods the Holland Marsh beside the highway in October.
timeline.zh: 10 月，飓风“黑兹尔”淹没公路旁的霍兰沼泽。

timeline.en: The two-lane extension to Coldwater opens on 24 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 24 日，通往冷水镇的双车道延伸段开通。

timeline.en: The freeway is extended south to Jane Street on 28 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 28 日，高速公路向南延伸至简街。

timeline.en: Twinning of the extension north of Barrie begins.
timeline.zh: 巴里以北延伸段开始加宽为双幅。

timeline.en: The stack interchange with Highway 407 opens on 7 June; rebuilt sections of Highway 69 begin to be renamed Highway 400.
timeline.zh: 6 月 7 日，与 407 号公路的多层立交开通；69 号公路已改建路段开始改称 400 号公路。
